response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing real-time credit/liquidity systems — critical for this CTO role.
strengths: Experienced in agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in distributed systems and real-time data apps (e.g., DLang microservices)
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership in tooling and infrastructure
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance
Lacks evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or building senior technical leadership layers
No clear production deployment of stateful, feedback-looped multi-agent systems in financial contexts
